name: Plantoir
headline: Plan the plot. Plant your notes. Grow a class website you own.
tagline: Turns a folder of Markdown notes into a fast, searchable class website.
downloads_note: The download cards on the home page. A card with no 'pinned' version links GitHub's evergreen releases/latest/download/<asset>, which 404s for a platform whose installer is missing from the newest release; such a card is pinned to the last release that has it, and says so. Windows is pinned to 1.1.0 because v1.2.0 onward carried the macOS DMG only: unpin it in the release that ships the Windows installer again. Asset names are frozen (RELEASING.md).

availability.note: On the Mac. The Windows version gets this in a later release.
availability.why: A section describing something the Windows download (see downloads: pinned to 1.1.0) does not have carries {{availability:<key>}}, which prints the note while 'windows' is false and nothing once it is true. Flip the boolean in the release whose Windows installer has the feature.

new_in.why: The home page's 'New this year' list. --deploy warns when this version is not the major.minor of 'version', so a 1.5 release is reminded to rewrite it; a 1.4.x is not.

items.text: A ready-made course for {{ready_made_ontario}} Ontario courses, and a starting outline for about {{skeleton_codes}} more.
